_comment: run-profiles.json - every Ansible run of the lab: what runs on ansible-control and which
credentials it gets. Read by the PC (scripts/lib/LabRun.ps1: Invoke-LabRun, '.\lab.ps1 run')
and by ansible-control (ansible/bin/lab-run, which gets a copy with every run).
playbook    an Ansible playbook, relative to ansible/ (run with ansible-playbook in ~/lab)
command     or a shell command instead, run in ~/lab (for example MDAD in ~/mdad)
principals  the SSH principals of ansible-control's certificate for this run (2 hours):
host-<vm> opens only that machine, lab-all every one; [] = no certificate (the
run stays on ansible-control). Least privilege per run.
policies    the OpenBao policies of the run's token (bound to ansible-control, revoked when
the run ends); none = no token
tokenRole   the token role it is minted through: ansible-run (the default; deployments,
2 hours, minted by pc-deploy) or ansible-config (OpenBao's configuration plane,
syncMdad    also copy vendor/mdad from the repository to ~/mdad first
Enterprise equivalent: job templates in AWX / Ansible Automation Platform, each with its own
